integrity: The universal proof is an explicit character-moment and Johnson-module diagonalization. Exact finite-field checks are supporting tests only. The 1975 foundational article was located bibliographically but its complete text was unavailable in this review; no independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The result covers only one chosen nontrivial additive frequency per off-diagonal coordinate on nonsingular alternating forms of even size at least six; it is not a claim about unrestricted Fourier masks, full-function reconstruction, optimal sampling among all configurations, or historical priority.
title: Exact coordinate Fourier spectra on nonsingular alternating forms and a dimension-eight transition
